title: cool.agent-receipt.v1
description: The Agent Execution Receipt: the human-readable view of one signed agent.execution envelope (cool.envelope.v1). The envelope is the signed source of truth; this view is derived from it and carries the envelope digest so the two can be matched. Raw inputs and outputs are never included, only keyed digests. See docs/agent-receipt.md for field meanings and the versioning rule.

timestamp.description: When the action was recorded (UTC, ISO 8601)

time_source.description: Where the timestamp came from and how far it can be trusted

agent_id.description: Declared identity of the agent. Not independently authenticated.

initiator_id.description: Declared person or system that asked for the action, or the literal 'unknown'

authority_ref.description: Reference to the approval, ticket or grant relied on (declared)

policy_version.description: Policy in force (declared; CooL does not prove enforcement)

sequence_number.description: <epoch>.<n>; contiguous per workspace epoch so a missing receipt shows as a gap

capture.description: How the receipt was captured; mcp_proxy records every call that passes through, the others record what the agent or hook chose to record

digest_scheme.description: HMAC-SHA-256 under the workspace's private commitment key over canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace), domain-separated per field

fingerprint.description: Workspace fingerprint over the receipt and log public keys; share it out of band to let others pin the keys

log.description: Workspace-relative path of the append-only receipt log
